title: Bird Feeder with Rain-Guard Roof and Twist-Lock Reservoir (4 parts)
description: Seed reservoir with four arched feeding ports locks into a catch tray by bayonet; a bayonet cap carries a hanging post, and a 144 mm cone roof slides down over it. The roof overhang keeps rain off the seed ports.
use: Hang from a branch or hook. Fill with sunflower or wild-bird seed, lock the cap, then slip the roof on. Clean the tray weekly.
material: PETG or ASA (outdoor UV), 0.2 mm layers, 4 perimeters. Print each part on its own plate: roof upside-down on its sleeve, cap upright, reservoir upright, tray flat. Food-contact: bird seed only, not for people.

problem_solved: Open bird feeders get rained on: seed clumps, molds and can sicken birds. Most printable feeders are open bowls. Here the roof overhang sheds rain from the ports, drain holes keep the tray from pooling, and twist-lock joints make filling and cleaning tool-free.
mechanism: Two 3-lug bayonet joints (tray-reservoir and reservoir-cap), a central hanging post that carries the load, and a loose cone roof that slides over the post.
tolerances: Lug 2.8 mm in 3.6 mm slot (0.4 clearance each side); reservoir 0.5 mm radial in collar; roof sleeve 0.2 mm radial to post shoulder 0.3 mm vertical; roof to cap >= 1 mm.
assembly: 1. Print tray, reservoir, cap+post, roof (each on its own plate).
2. Drop the reservoir lugs into the tray slots, twist ~30 deg.
3. Fill with bird seed through the top, drop the cap on, twist ~30 deg.
4. Slide the roof over the post until it rests on the shoulder.
5. Tie cord through the post eye.
fit_notes: Roof and tray exceed a 150 mm bed if combined: print the parts separately. Load: seed fill about 0.35 kg (not tested). Clean weekly with hot soapy water.

validation.plate_note: STL lays all parts out on one preview plate (larger than a 150 mm bed); print each part separately.
